due_when.clears_when: _patch_env_var escapes the delimiter it uses (or writes via a non-sed path) with a test for a value containing '|', OR killed with a reason

origin.rerun: sed -n 84,115p scripts/ops/sync_vm_secrets.sh — check the delimiter of the in-place sed against the escape set; reproduce with a temp .env holding KEY=a and a new value 'x|y'.

what: Pre-existing (manager review of #14682, 2026-09-30): scripts/ops/sync_vm_secrets.sh _patch_env_var escapes only / & \ for its sed replacement but the sed UPDATE uses '|' as delimiter, so a later UPDATE of an existing secret whose value contains '|' fails or corrupts that .env line. A first sync APPENDS (safe for any character); only a rotation of an existing key is exposed.
